test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

If you want to have two cats, a male and a female __will usually gotten__ along.
solution:
The correct answer is **option (2)** i.e. **"will usually get".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined part **"****will usually gotten"__** is not grammatically correct.
 
• It is a conditional sentence. The first part "**If you want to have two cats"** is grammatically correct.
 
• In the second part **"a male and a female"** are the subjects.
 
• **'Will'** is a helping verb. After **'will'** the verb must be in its base form i.e. **V1.**
 
• That's why **'gotten' **must be replaced by **'get'. **Because **'gotten' **is past participle form (V3) of the verb** 'get' (V1).**
 __
 
• **For example: **
 
 
• Aryan **will gone** to school next day.**(Incorrect****)**
 
• Aryan **will go** to school next day.(Correct)
 
 
 
 

 Therefore the correct sentence is ***"****If you want to have two cats, a male and a female **will usually get__** along**"***.
